note.zh-TW: Airbnb 條款沒有列出適用地區；此優惠以新台幣顯示，其他地區是否適用未確認。
note.en: Airbnb’s terms list no eligible regions; this offer is shown in NT$, and whether it applies elsewhere was not checked.

label.zh-TW: Airbnb 體驗邀請計畫條款

title.zh-TW: 好友首次預訂 Airbnb 體驗，可得 NT$815 折抵優惠
title.en: NT$815 off a friend’s first Airbnb Experience

text.zh-TW: Airbnb 條款以 US$25 計並要求訂單達 US$50 以上，NT$ 金額可能是美元換算，實際金額也可能不同。取自分享文案與邀請條款；以官方條款為準。
text.en: Airbnb’s terms say US$25 with a US$50 minimum booking, so NT$ is likely a conversion and may differ. From the share text and terms; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（沒有邀請碼；會先轉到 Airbnb 登入／註冊頁）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (no code; it first redirects to the Airbnb log-in / sign-up page).

steps.zh-TW: 先登入或註冊 Airbnb 帳號；依條款需登入後開啟連結才會套用，若沒有出現優惠，請回到本頁再開啟一次（未測試）。
steps.en: Log in or sign up first; per the terms the offer needs a logged-in click. If none appears, reopen the link from this page (not tested).

steps.zh-TW: 選擇 Airbnb 體驗並預訂首次體驗，訂單需達最低金額（條款寫 US$50，是否適用未確認）。
steps.en: Choose an Airbnb Experience and book your first one; the order must meet the minimum (the terms say US$50; whether it applies was not confirmed).

steps.zh-TW: 結帳時確認折抵優惠已套用；實際金額以官方條款為準。
steps.en: At checkout, check that the discount is applied; the actual amount follows the official terms.

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請連結預訂首次 Airbnb 體驗，依分享文案，被邀請的好友可得 NT$815 折抵優惠。
intro.en: Book a first Airbnb Experience via this invite link; per the share text, the invited friend gets NT$815 off.

description.zh-TW:
Airbnb 是住宿預訂平台，「體驗」是其中的活動預訂服務，例如導覽與課程。這是邀請人專屬的邀請連結，沒有另外的邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結開啟。

依分享文案，被邀請的好友首次預訂 Airbnb 體驗可得 NT$815 折抵優惠。Airbnb 體驗邀請條款寫的最低訂單是 US$50，這條連結是否適用沒有確認。實際內容以官方條款為準。
description.en:
Airbnb is a platform for booking stays, and Experiences (體驗) is its section for booking activities such as tours and classes. This is the referrer’s personal invite link with no separate invite code, so open the link on this page directly.

According to the share text, an invited friend gets NT$815 off a first Airbnb Experience. Airbnb’s Experiences referral terms mention a US$50 minimum booking; whether that applies to this link was not confirmed. Actual terms follow Airbnb’s official terms.

notes.zh-TW: 這是邀請人專屬連結，沒有可輸入的邀請碼。連結會先轉到 Airbnb 登入／註冊頁；本站沒有測試登入後是否套用優惠，也沒有測試優惠是否入帳。NT$ 金額取自分享文案，Airbnb 條款以美元計，金額可能調整。無法確認這條連結屬於哪一項 Airbnb 推薦計畫，所以不寫期限，條款中的 US$ 金額與最低訂單金額也可能不適用。依條款，點擊連結後邀請人可看到你的名稱與訂單資訊。
notes.en: This is the referrer’s personal link with no invite code to type in. It first redirects to the Airbnb log-in / sign-up page; this site did not test whether the offer is applied after logging in, nor whether it is credited. The NT$ amounts come from the share text, while Airbnb’s terms use US dollars and amounts may change. This site could not confirm which Airbnb referral programme the link belongs to, so no deadline is stated, and the US$ amounts and minimum from the terms may not apply. Under the terms, once you click the link the referrer can see your name and booking details.

q.zh-TW: Airbnb 體驗的邀請連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need an invite code for the Airbnb Experiences invite link?

a.zh-TW: 不需要。這條連結沒有邀請碼，優惠與連結綁定；依條款，需登入後開啟連結才會套用。
a.en: No. This link has no invite code, and the offer is tied to the link; per the terms it applies only if you are logged in when you open it.

q.zh-TW: NT$815 的優惠給誰？有什麼條件？
q.en: Who gets the NT$815 offer, and what are the conditions?

a.zh-TW: 折抵優惠給被邀請的好友，限首次預訂 Airbnb 體驗；條款寫的最低訂單是 US$50，是否適用於這條連結沒有確認。邀請人的回饋是另一方的權益，不屬於好友的優惠。
a.en: The discount is for the invited friend and only on a first Airbnb Experience booking; the terms mention a US$50 minimum, and whether it applies to this link was not confirmed. The referrer’s reward is a separate benefit, not part of the friend’s offer.
